player_prompt.intro:
Ad ur tẓri {N} imḍanen uffiren s umatar.
Di kraygat aseggas, arki [accept] akken ad dduḍḍet aɣlan *agdidan*, neɣ [continue] akken ad tḥayyiḍt ɣur-s ɣas d netta.
Ma ulac aɣlan, aɣ-ikkes ad dduḍḍet aɣlan aneggaru.
Tiririt (tazmilt = 1) **ɣas** ma aɣlan i dduḍḍen taneggarut iga aɣlan meqqren akk.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asebded yettwabni d akken ad yili [accept] neɣ [continue].
